- Initialize a counter to 0 and use two pointers i=0 and j=len(arr)-1; iterate while i<j, comparing arr[i] and arr[j].
- For each pair where arr[i] != arr[j], increment the counter by 1 (since changing either one element suffices to match the other).
- Return the counter after the loop, as it represents the minimum number of changes needed to make the array palindromic.
